purpose: Teach: 課す/形容/メンツ/熟知/表向き/細々/退会/寄附

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新人にも一定の課題を課すように指導しろ
lines.en: Make sure we give new recruits substantive challenges too — guide the team accordingly.
lines.style: Clear, measured command. Opens with quiet authority. Expects compliance, not discussion. Steady pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品を一言で形容するキャッチコピーを準備しました
lines.en: Yes. I've prepared a one-line catchphrase that describes the new product.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient report. Speaks with quiet confidence in his own preparation. Direct eye contact. Brief — he's done his homework and it shows without needing to elaborate.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: お取引先との会食で、メンツを潰さないようにしろ
lines.en: At partner dinners, don't let us lose face. Represent carefully.
lines.style: Sharp, knowing instruction. Weight on the stakes. Leans slightly forward. The tone of a senior who has seen reputations fumbled and won't tolerate it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場動向を熟知した社員を選任しました
lines.en: Yes. I've assigned one of our market-savvy staff members to attend.
lines.style: Assured update. Speaks as though he anticipated this exact instruction. Calm delivery, no defensiveness. The quiet satisfaction of someone who was already thinking three steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、表向きの方針と現場の運用を一致させろ
lines.en: Align what we say publicly with what we actually do on the ground. Close the gap.
lines.style: Firm, philosophical. Not angry — more disappointed by compromise itself. Pause before the second sentence. The tone of someone looking at a recurring problem he expects will finally be fixed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。細々とした業務改善を継続しております
lines.en: Yes. We're continuing to make small, steady operational improvements across the board.
lines.style: Steady, unflinching confirmation. No apology, no over-explaining. Speaks with the weight of ongoing work already in motion. Slight nod on 'continuing' — he knows this won't be solved overnight.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お得意様の退会を防ぐ方策を立てろ
lines.en: Develop a strategy to keep our valued long-term customers from leaving.
lines.style: Serious, focused directive. No room for half-measures. Lower register, slower pace. The tone of someone naming what matters most to the business's survival.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域への寄附活動を継続しております
lines.en: Yes. We're maintaining our community contribution activities — that's part of it.
lines.style: Concluding affirmation. Softer than previous updates — almost contemplative. Acknowledges the bigger picture beyond transactions. Slight trailing-off, as though he knows retention is about more than quarterly returns.
